title: Learner item-response record (IRT difficulty-calibration seam)
description: One learner response to one assessable item, the record shape read by the response-ingestion seam at lib/assessment/irt_difficulty.py::load_calibrated_difficulty (resolved from <libv2>/courses/<slug>/responses/item_responses.jsonl, one record per line). The seam computes a deterministic proportion-correct -> difficulty band ONLY for items with >= min_responses real records; it NEVER fabricates IRT parameters. This file documents the contract ONLY — no response data is committed to the repository.

item_id.description: Id of the assessable item the response is for. Either item_id or chunk_id MUST be present; chunk_id is preferred when the item is anchored to a chunk.

chunk_id.description: Id of the chunk the assessable item is anchored to (the calibrated-map key consumed by tag_chunk_difficulty_provenance). Preferred over item_id when present.

learner_id.description: Opaque learner identifier (pseudonymous). Used only to count distinct responses; never resolved to a person.

correct.description: Whether the learner answered the item correctly. Required and strictly boolean — a non-boolean grade is dropped by the seam, never coerced.

score.description: Optional raw/partial score for the response (not consumed by the binary proportion-correct calibrator; reserved for a future graded-response model).
